name: stage_redirects
description:
Stage a new version of a project's bulk redirects from the provided redirect rules, and return the new version. Staged redirects do not change production until promoted with update_bulk_redirect_version.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/bulk-redirects --method PUT. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
